rows.title: Nepal Satellite Atlas
rows.state: An unverified atlas and river-and-terrain explorer were complete locally. Radar review found coarse agreement in ten windows, with six empty windows unsupported. The scientific goal remained blocked by missing independent registration evidence and an outstanding source-provider response; sharpening belonged to a separate learning project.

rows.title: Portfolio Website
rows.state: Four designed case-study pages and a contribution-first homepage were complete locally. At this cutoff, final shared-site review and handoff remained unfinished; nothing new had been published and the portfolio goal remained ongoing.

source.label: Daily Project Recap — selected portfolio-project snapshot
filters: Five portfolio-relevant project records from stored October 7, 2026 session. Daily cutoff: 5:00 PM Pacific. No source refresh.
Exclude four unrelated projects, full activity histories, private paths, forecasts, private URLs and operational controls.

metricDefinitions.label: Listed tasks completed
metricDefinitions.definition: Number of completed checklist tasks among listed tasks in the dated project plan. Tasks have different scope and weight. This is not effort, hours, whole-project percentage or scientific acceptance.

metricDefinitions.label: Source reviewed
metricDefinitions.definition: Each project's retained source-review timestamp. It is not refreshed when a quiet project is carried into a later daily session.

caveats: This is a dated selected snapshot, not a live dashboard. The portfolio record predates this Freljord/carousel design study.
All five projects remained ongoing at the recorded cutoff. Completed engineering tasks do not establish scientific acceptance or human multiplayer acceptance.
No owner forecasts or planning-point percentage is copied.

methods.code: Select the five latest stored phase-project rows for session 2026-10-07; require coveredThrough 2026-10-08T00:00:00Z. Preserve each reviewedAt. Parse modulesJSON, count all listed modules/tasks and statuses recorded complete. Project fields: id, title, sourceTitle, category, sourceReviewedAt, coveredThrough, session, completedTasks, plannedTasks, completedModules, plannedModules, caseRoute, state. Do not copy modulesJSON, full activity, paths, forecasts or private URLs. Portfolio-facing title aliases match existing case pages; state prose is shortened without removing material qualifiers.
